## Common WHERE Filters

```sql
-- 单日分区 + 单区域过滤 (最常用)
WHERE grass_date = date('${grass_date}')
  AND grass_region = upper('${region}')

-- 7天范围过滤 (用于 product_click_order 回刷)
WHERE grass_region = upper('${region}')
  AND grass_date BETWEEN date_sub('${grass_date}', 7) AND date_sub('${grass_date}', 1)

-- 实验分组筛选
WHERE group_id IN (137094, 137095, 137096)

-- 时区过滤 (生产环境固定 local)
WHERE tz_type = 'local'
```

## Common JOIN Patterns

```sql
-- Pattern 1: user_id 关联获取 group_id (最常用 — 每日实验效果聚合)
SELECT tab1.*, tab2.group_id
FROM ads_performance_base tab1
INNER JOIN mp_paidads.dim_live_stream_abtest_group__reg_s0_live tab2
  ON tab1.user_id = tab2.user_id
WHERE tab2.grass_date = date('${grass_date}')
  AND tab2.grass_region = upper('${region}')

-- Pattern 2: user_id + grass_date 双键关联 (7天回溯回刷)
SELECT tab1.*, tab2.group_id
FROM product_click_order_attribution tab1
INNER JOIN mp_paidads.dim_live_stream_abtest_group__reg_s0_live tab2
  ON tab1.user_id = tab2.user_id
  AND tab1.product_click_date = tab2.grass_date
WHERE tab2.grass_region = upper('${region}')
  AND tab2.grass_date BETWEEN date_sub('${grass_date}', 7) AND date_sub('${grass_date}', 1)
```

## Common Aggregations

本表为维度映射表，不直接参与聚合。下游消费表通过 JOIN 获取 group_id 后，按 group_id 聚合指标：

```sql
-- 下游聚合模式: 按 group_id + 业务维度 聚合
SELECT grass_region, entrance, placement, group_id, pricing_type, streamer_type, ads_id,
  SUM(impression_cnt) AS ads_imp_cnt,
  SUM(view) AS ads_view_cnt,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN view > 0 THEN user_id END) AS ads_view_uu,
  SUM(order_cnt) AS ads_direct_order_cnt,
  SUM(ads_rev) AS ads_revenue
FROM (
  SELECT tab1.*, tab2.group_id
  FROM ads_performance_base tab1
  INNER JOIN mp_paidads.dim_live_stream_abtest_group__reg_s0_live tab2
    ON tab1.user_id = tab2.user_id
) t
GROUP BY grass_region, entrance, placement, group_id, pricing_type, streamer_type, ads_id
```

### Snippet 2: dws 用户级实验效果 — group_id 关联 (workflow)

```sql
-- 获取每个用户的实验分组后按 group_id + 维度 聚合
SELECT grass_region, date('${grass_date}') AS grass_date,
  entrance, placement, group_id, pricing_type, streamer_type, ads_id,
  SUM(impression_cnt) AS impression_cnt,
  SUM(view) AS view,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN view > 0 THEN user_id END) AS view_uu,
  SUM(ads_rev) AS ads_rev
FROM (
  SELECT tab1.*, group_id
  FROM ads_performance_base tab1
  INNER JOIN mp_paidads.dim_live_stream_abtest_group__reg_s0_live tab2
    ON tab1.user_id = tab2.user_id
  WHERE tab2.grass_date = date('${grass_date}')
    AND tab2.grass_region = upper('${region}')
)
GROUP BY grass_region, entrance, placement, group_id, pricing_type, streamer_type, ads_id
```

### Snippet 3: 7天 product_click_order 回刷 — user_id + grass_date 关联

```sql
SELECT group_id, placement, entrance, pricing_type, streamer_type, product_click_date, ads_id,
  SUM(product_click_order_new) AS product_click_order_new
FROM (
  SELECT tab1.*, tab2.group_id
  FROM product_click_order_attribution tab1
  INNER JOIN mp_paidads.dim_live_stream_abtest_group__reg_s0_live tab2
    ON tab1.user_id = tab2.user_id
    AND tab1.product_click_date = tab2.grass_date
  WHERE tab2.grass_region = upper('${region}')
    AND tab2.grass_date BETWEEN date_sub('${grass_date}', 7) AND date_sub('${grass_date}', 1)
)
GROUP BY group_id, placement, entrance, pricing_type, streamer_type, product_click_date, ads_id
```

    ON tab1.user_id = tab2.user_id

### Snippet 5: 带 if_promote_others 维度关联 (workflow, newer version)

```sql
SELECT grass_region, entrance, placement, user_id, pricing_type, streamer_type, ads_id, if_promote_others,
  SUM(impression_cnt) AS impression_cnt,
  SUM(ads_rev) AS ads_rev
FROM ads_performance_origin ads_base
LEFT OUTER JOIN (
  SELECT ls_session_id, if_promote_others, streamer_type
  FROM livestream.ls_mart_dim_ls_session_ext
  WHERE grass_date = date('${grass_date}')
    AND grass_region = upper('${region}')
    AND tz_type = 'local'
  GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
) c ON ads_base.ls_session_id = c.ls_session_id
GROUP BY ads_base.grass_region, entrance, placement, user_id, pricing_type, streamer_type, ads_id, if_promote_others

```

### 分区写入策略

- tz_type 固定为 'local'
- grass_region 和 grass_date 由调度变量 ${region} 和 ${grass_date} 注入
- 每个区域独立任务，每日覆盖当天分区
